content: Apple Inc. announced the iPhone 15 Pro at its September 2023 event in Cupertino. The device features a titanium frame, an A17 Pro chip, and a 48-megapixel main camera. Tim Cook emphasized sustainability and supply-chain improvements during the keynote.

CRITICAL: The production API gateway experienced a complete outage from 14:00 to 15:47 UTC on 2026-07-29. All customer-facing services returned 503 errors. The root cause was a misconfigured rate-limit rule deployed in release v2.14.0. A rollback to v2.13.4 restored service.

After reviewing three options, the platform team decided to adopt PostgreSQL over MongoDB for the billing service. The decision was recorded in ADR-042. Primary drivers were ACID compliance, existing operational expertise, and the need for complex relational queries. MongoDB will remain for the analytics pipeline.
Daily stand-up notes for the mobile team: Sarah finished the login screen refactor, Marcus is still debugging a layout issue on iPad, and the team agreed to move the weekly demo to Thursday at 10am.
